name: CodeSensei interview preparation

baseline.coding_environment: Browser editor with execution and test cases

standout: Personalized follow-up drill based on actual mistakes in each mock interview.
selling_point: Your next practice session starts where your last interview went wrong.
research_question: How does preference compare with existing interview-preparation tools and free resources?
design_notes: Original agreed hypothetical offer; no calculated median or complete competitor research. No two deliberate disadvantages were agreed for this original concept.
